items.question: By what range of avian forms is the class of knowing beings extended on earth in addition to those already named?
premises: A set of owl-like and peacock-like forms is named as knowing beings.
Disjunctive particles allow for alternative forms within that class.
A further pair of forms is added by way of comparison to the preceding list.
items.inference: The class of earthbound knowing beings includes these additional avian forms as alternatives or parallels to those already listed.
uncertainties: The exact zoological referents of sararī and gūlī remain uncertain.
The precise scope of vā and tu in delimiting alternatives is not fully clear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Likewise, the owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sararī-woman or the gūlī-woman.
